description: This PHP source file defines the InstallerCountryListCommand class, which is a console command for listing countries and retrieving a specific country code in the OrangeHRM human resource management system. It extends the InstallerCommand base class and interfaces with the InstanceCreationHelper to get country data.

classes.name: InstallerCountryListCommand
classes.description: A console command class for listing countries or fetching the country code by name within the installer component of OrangeHRM.

methods.name: getCommandName
methods.description: Returns the name of the console command, 'install:country-list'.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Configures command-line options, adding a 'country' option for filtering the country list.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main execution method that retrieves the list of countries, optionally filters by a specified country name, and outputs the result.
